meta.title: Email Notifications: on failure — after failures, notification logged as 'undelivered'
gaps: Configure INT-005 Email Notifications and its provider settings.
Make the external email provider fail or become unreachable.
Trigger an approval request, bid invitation, PO issuance, or other workflow event.
Observe and assert that the notification is logged specifically as undelivered and not silently dropped.
